definitions.explanation: A day when the maximum temperature reaches 30°C (86°F) or higher. An official meteorological term used by the Japan Meteorological Agency.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{真夏日|まなつび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{予報|よほう}→予報：03668_yohou⟧だ。
examples.english: Today is forecast to be a hot summer day.

examples.japanese: {真夏日|まなつび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真夏日|まなつび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日数|にっすう}→日数：12953_nissuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{過去最多|かこさいた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記録|きろく}した→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧。
examples.english: This year recorded the highest number of hot summer days in history.

notes:
An official meteorological term used by the Japan Meteorological Agency (⟦{気象庁|きしょうちょう}→気象庁：30107_kishouchou⟧) to classify days when the maximum temperature reaches 30°C or higher.

FORMS:
⟦{真夏|まなつ}→真夏：27793_manatsu⟧ (midsummer) + {日|び} (day)

METEOROLOGICAL TERMS:
Japan has official categories for hot days:
- {夏日|なつび}: 25°C or above
- {真夏日|まなつび}: 30°C or above
- ⟦{猛暑日|もうしょび}→猛暑日：09622_moushobi⟧: 35°C or above

USAGE:
Commonly appears in weather forecasts and news reports, especially during summer months. The number of {真夏日|まなつび} per year is tracked as a climate indicator.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{熱帯夜|ねったいや}→熱帯夜：10187_nettaiya⟧: tropical night (minimum above 25°C)
- ⟦{猛暑|もうしょ}→猛暑：08311_mousho⟧: extreme heat
- ⟦{酷暑|こくしょ}→酷暑：08324_kokusho⟧: intense heat
